question: What was total revenue in the last 30 days?
expected_sql: SELECT MEASURE(`Revenue`) FROM {FQ}.order_metrics WHERE `Order Date` >= current_date() - INTERVAL 30 DAYS

question: What was revenue by region in the last 90 days?
expected_sql: SELECT `Region`, MEASURE(`Revenue`) FROM {FQ}.order_metrics WHERE `Order Date` >= current_date() - INTERVAL 90 DAYS GROUP BY ALL

question: How many orders were placed last week?
expected_sql: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM {FQ}.orders WHERE order_date >= current_date() - INTERVAL 7 DAYS

question: How many orders were late last week in the North region?
expected_sql: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM {FQ}.orders WHERE region = 'North' AND eta > promised_date AND status <> 'cancelled' AND order_date >= current_date() - INTERVAL 7 DAYS

question: Which region has the highest late delivery rate this quarter?
expected_sql: SELECT `Region`, MEASURE(`Late Rate`) AS late_rate FROM {FQ}.order_metrics WHERE `Order Date` >= DATE_TRUNC('QUARTER', current_date()) GROUP BY ALL ORDER BY late_rate DESC LIMIT 1

question: What is the average order value by customer tier?
expected_sql: SELECT c.tier, SUM(o.amount) / COUNT(DISTINCT o.order_id) FROM {FQ}.orders o JOIN {FQ}.customers c USING (customer_id) WHERE o.status <> 'cancelled' GROUP BY c.tier

question: How many cancelled orders were there in the last 30 days?
expected_sql: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM {FQ}.orders WHERE status = 'cancelled' AND order_date >= current_date() - INTERVAL 30 DAYS

question: Top 5 products by units sold in the last 90 days
expected_sql: SELECT p.product_name, SUM(l.quantity) AS units FROM {FQ}.order_lines l JOIN {FQ}.products p USING (product_id) JOIN {FQ}.orders o USING (order_id) WHERE o.order_date >= current_date() - INTERVAL 90 DAYS GROUP BY ALL ORDER BY units DESC LIMIT 5

question: Revenue by product category this year
expected_sql: SELECT p.category, SUM(l.quantity * l.unit_price) FROM {FQ}.order_lines l JOIN {FQ}.products p USING (product_id) JOIN {FQ}.orders o USING (order_id) WHERE o.status <> 'cancelled' AND YEAR(o.order_date) = YEAR(current_date()) GROUP BY ALL

question: How many gold customers do we have?
expected_sql: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM {FQ}.customers WHERE tier = 'gold'

question: Monthly revenue trend for the last 6 months
expected_sql: SELECT `Order Month`, MEASURE(`Revenue`) FROM {FQ}.order_metrics WHERE `Order Date` >= ADD_MONTHS(current_date(), -6) GROUP BY ALL ORDER BY 1

question: Which city in the West region had the most orders last month?
expected_sql: SELECT city, COUNT(*) AS n FROM {FQ}.orders WHERE region = 'West' AND order_date >= ADD_MONTHS(DATE_TRUNC('MONTH', current_date()), -1) AND order_date < DATE_TRUNC('MONTH', current_date()) GROUP BY city ORDER BY n DESC LIMIT 1

question: What share of orders are currently shipped but not delivered?
expected_sql: SELECT COUNT_IF(status = 'shipped') / COUNT(*) FROM {FQ}.orders

question: Average delivery delay in days for late orders by region
expected_sql: SELECT region, AVG(DATEDIFF(eta, promised_date)) FROM {FQ}.orders WHERE eta > promised_date GROUP BY region

question: Revenue for fiscal quarter of today
expected_sql: SELECT MEASURE(`Revenue`) FROM {FQ}.order_metrics WHERE `Fiscal Quarter` = CONCAT('FY', YEAR(ADD_MONTHS(current_date(), -3)), '-Q', QUARTER(ADD_MONTHS(current_date(), -3)))

question: How many distinct customers ordered in the last 30 days?
expected_sql: SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT customer_id) FROM {FQ}.orders WHERE order_date >= current_date() - INTERVAL 30 DAYS

question: Number of orders by status
expected_sql: SELECT status, COUNT(*) FROM {FQ}.orders GROUP BY status
